role: The nether's magma cube: a fire-immune slime that takes no fall damage, jumps with 0.42 + 0.1*size velocity, and hits harder on touch.

members.name: EntityMagmaCube
members.note: the SK_MAGMA_CUBE branch: setImmuneToFire (slimes.c:68) and the size body

members.name: applyEntityAttributes
members.note: maxHealth (size*size) and movement (0.2*size) on the magma branch

members.name: getCanSpawnHere
members.note: the magma cube's nether-provider guard is not a separate branch in can_spawn_here_slime; the nether spawn lists place it

members.name: getBrightnessForRender
members.note: the renderer's light, constant 15728880 whatever the world's light, with getBrightness 1.0F as the hurt overlay's scalar (csrc/play's mob_self_lit, lane/glowfix; clientframes/cov-zoo-s1)

members.name: getBrightness
members.note: runs only when a frame is drawn (the renderer): covframes' frame coverage runs it in its cf-cov-zoo-s1

members.name: dropFewItems
members.note: the magma branch: 0-2+looting cream only when size > 1 (slimes.c:285-296)

members.name: isBurning
members.note: false always: cov-mobs-s1 hits a magma cube with Fire Aspect (setFire(1) runs, the immunity keeps it from burning)

members.name: fall
members.note: the empty override is living_fall's SK_MAGMA_CUBE early return

members.name: canDamagePlayer
members.note: always true for the magma cube (slimes.c:340-343)

members.name: handleLavaMovement
members.note: the lava-drag immunity folds into the shared pre-update body

members.name: makesSoundOnLand
members.note: always true for the magma cube (slimes.c:111)

notes: EntitySlime's base machinery is slimes.c; EntityMagmaCube's deltas are the SK_MAGMA_CUBE branches. test_slimes.c is the acceptance gate.
